brief: A desk organizer with two bins that looks handsome next to my walnut desk and matches its warm tone.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full cells (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full) with desk props (pen, pencil, ruler) staged in bins; look from 45/62 sees props.
requirements.requirement: Desk organizer (usable on a desk, staged for desk use)

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full (full depth) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments); 2 bin parts in BOM.
Compact 2-cell body, capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied, check_build clear with no errors; look confirms tidy build with visible desk tools.
requirements.requirement: Looks handsome next to a desk

requirements.evidence: Colour/material match cannot be shown or checked: parts are 3D-printed in a user-chosen material and the configurator checks fit only. Print in a warm brown chosen to sit beside walnut if desired, but match is not verified by this build.
requirements.requirement: Matches the warm tone of walnut desk

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-cell organizer with 2 bins (one plain full-depth, one 2-compartment), capped, locked, mesh-clear and staged with desk tools. Warm-tone/walnut colour match is unmet — material and colour are chosen by the user at print time and cannot be verified here.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
